recipe.check: 新进程重开后搜索目标词、复制文字、检查元数据与图像内敏感内容。
recipe.boundary: 仅画黑框不算脱敏；find示例必须替换为实际授权范围，不误删相似非敏感内容。 doc_audit_redactions只审计假遮盖，不能证明所有元数据、附件、表单或像素内秘密都消失；隐藏信息须按已授权类别另行处理，不能无条件删除全部内容。
recipe.argumentPolicy: 示例参数必须按当前输入、选择和实际返回ID替换；$变量先解析，数组变量整字段替换，不能将本文件直接当原生CLI脚本执行。

redact_mark.description: Mark content for redaction (nothing is removed until redact_apply). One of: rect [x0, y0, x1, y1] (points from the top-left of the displayed page) with page; find (text, every match); words (a list of words or phrases, every match of each; the result's matched_words says how many marks each made); pattern (phone, email, credit-card, ssn, date: every match, Acrobat's Search & Redact patterns); whole_pages: true. find and words accept case_sensitive and whole_words (both default false). find, words, pattern and whole_pages work on pages (default all). overlay: text shown on the box once applied, or code_set (foia: U.S. FOIA (b)(1)(A)…(b)(9); privacy-act: U.S. Privacy Act (d)(5), (j)(1)…(k)(7)) with codes, shown as "(b)(6), (b)(7)(C)"; fill: box colour (default black). Undoable.

case_sensitive.description: Match letter case for find or words (default false).

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers to search or mark (default: all).

whole_words.description: Match whole words for find or words (default false).

redact_mark.name: redact_mark

redact_apply.description: Apply the redaction marks (all, or those on pages): text, images, vectors, comments and form fields under them are removed for good and boxes are drawn in their place. A verification pass fails the operation if anything readable remains. Undoable until saved; the saved file no longer contains the content.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers whose marks to apply (default: all).

redact_apply.name: redact_apply

doc_audit_redactions.description: Find faux redactions: opaque filled rectangles painted over text that is still extractable, and /Redact annotations that were marked but never applied. Paint-order and colour-aware: a rectangle counts only when painted after the text and dark enough to hide it (page backgrounds and light shading are not flagged). Each finding reports the 1-based page, the kind (covered-text or unapplied-mark), the rectangle, and the hidden text. Fails closed: unreadable content is an error, never a clean bill. A properly applied redaction removes the text and never flags.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

doc_audit_redactions.name: doc_audit_redactions

doc_save.description: Save to its own file (an incremental update, which keeps signatures valid) or to a new path (a full rewrite). The write is atomic. flatten_fill_sign bakes Fill & Sign text, marks and signatures into the page first and removes those annotations; other comments and form fields stay. Omit it, or pass false, to leave them editable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

flatten_fill_sign.description: Bake Fill & Sign marks into the page before writing. Default false.

full.description: Force a full rewrite (or, with false, an incremental update).

path.description: Save as this file. Omit to save in place.

doc_save.name: doc_save

text_extract.description: Extract the text of some or all pages, in reading order. With rect, only the text inside that rectangle on each page, as Column select takes it: one row per visual line, side-by-side pieces (table cells) separated by a tab.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

rect.description: Column select: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points from the top-left of the displayed page; a glyph counts when its centre is inside.

text_extract.name: text_extract

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.
